entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 18211043587721088, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc9a7. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; gaia-xp: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,100 K and log g 4.36 (u1 0.724, u2 0.065): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Spin
entries.finding: Inclination 39 degrees from the line of sight, period 4.83 d, from Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: rotation period 4.83 d and an axis 39 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with; the axis's direction on the sky is a convention.
